title: Finance Charge History and the Prompt-Payment Discount Rate (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
The payment record of a Commercial Credit Account sets how much of the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage enters **the discount rate** of a catch-up prompt-payment discount on an invoice dated inside the current term, from its effective date through its expiration date, of the customer's live Contract Pricing Agreement (its one agreement whose status is active or renewal pending).

### Clause

The payment-record share of the discount rate is nothing for an account charged two or more late payment finance charges dated less than twelve whole months before today, one half for an account charged exactly one such charge, and the whole rate for an account charged none. The share multiplies the tier's percentage.

Whole months between a date and today are the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month, with no move of a month-end date to a shorter month's last day.

### Schedule

| Late payment finance charges dated less than 12 whole months before today | Share of the tier's percentage |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | nothing (0 percent) |
| exactly 1 | one half (50 percent) |
| none | the whole (100 percent) |

### Counting the charges (hypothetical, today 15 June)

| Finance charge dated | Whole months before today | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June of the previous year | 11 | yes |
| 15 June of the previous year | 12 | no |
| 31 May of the previous year, with today 30 May | 11 | yes |

*Hypothetical rate:* on a 1 percent tier, one counted finance charge gives a share of 50 percent and a rate of 0.5 percent; two or more give a rate of nothing.
